reasons: CS4226 is only offered in Sem 1, but the student is in Y2S2 (Sem 2) and future years follow the same offering pattern, so Sem 1 of Y3 (Sem 5) is the earliest available slot. However, CS4226 requires CS2105. CS2105 requires CS2040S (completed). So CS2105 can be taken in Sem 3 or 4. If CS2105 is taken in Sem 4, CS4226 can be taken in Sem 5 (Y3S1).

CS4231 is only offered in Sem 2. It requires CS3210 or CS3230. CS3210 requires CS2100 (completed). CS3230 requires CS2040S (completed) and CS1231S (completed). So CS3230 can be taken in Sem 3 or 4. If CS3230 is taken in Sem 4, CS4231 can be taken in Sem 6 (Y3S2).

The student wants CS4226 and CS2109S together. CS2109S requires CS4231. So CS4231 must be in the same semester as CS4226 and CS2109S. But CS4226 is only offered in Sem 1, and CS4231 is only offered in Sem 2. They cannot be in the same semester.
Therefore, it is impossible to satisfy the wish to take CS4226 and CS2109S together.
